title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Bio-Image Analysis Code Generation

dependence.note: 핵심 결과(모델별 pass-rate)가 전적으로 상용 모델 출력에 의존. 코드·테스트·원 샘플·채점 결과 전부 공개 (L1 충족 사례)

claim.statement: gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 solves 47.4% of 57 bio-image-analysis coding tasks at pass@1 (10 samples per task), on par with the leading models (claude-3-5-sonnet 58%, gpt-4o-2024-05-13 50%).
claim.metric: pass@1 (HumanEval estimator, n=10 per task, mean over 57 tasks)

protocol.temperature: not set (API default 1.0) — matches original notebook
protocol.seed: not set — matches original; system_fingerprint logged
protocol.prompt_template:
Complete the following code. 
    First, write down a plan as comments how to solve the problem step-by-step.
    Then, import the python libraries you think you will use.
    Then, write the function you were asked for.
    Write python code only.
    Do NOT write any code for testing the function.
    Return the complete code including my code.

```python
{input_code}
```
protocol.evaluation: HumanEval exec harness from repo (execution.py logic, exec enabled in our copy), Python 3.10 venv with repo requirements; timeout per card run_meta
protocol.environment_check: canonical solutions must be run first in our venv (reference pass rate) to separate environment drift from model drift

budget.estimate_usd: 6-8 (paper reported $13.02 for two gpt-4 models at same pricing)

judgment.survival_rule: ANALYSIS_PLAN §1. 생존: pass@1 within original ± bootstrap 95% CI over tasks and direction of ranking claim holds
judgment.notes: temperature 1.0 sampling → run-to-run variance expected; report bootstrap CI over 57 tasks
